units.source_text: 也许在这位美国人看来，用还在语法学习阶段的外国话讲话，就像争吵；

en.t: Perhaps to this American, speaking in a foreign language that was still at the stage of grammar study was like arguing;

units.source_text: 再说他对这种消遣比赛不当一回事。

en.t: besides, he did not take this sort of recreational contest seriously.

units.source_text: 总而言之，我同他下棋跟同日本人下棋很不一样，这倒是事实。

en.t: In any case, it was true that playing go with him was very different from playing with a Japanese person.

units.source_text: 有时我想，围棋对西方人来说，可能不大合适。

en.t: At times I thought that go might not be very well suited to Westerners.

units.source_text: 因为在箱根人们经常谈到围棋爱好者在迪瓦尔博士的德国有五千人，

en.t: For in Hakone people often said that in Dr. Dival's Germany there were five thousand go enthusiasts,

units.source_text: 围棋在美国也开始受到欢迎。

en.t: and go was also beginning to become popular in America.

units.source_text: 我以一个初学的美国人为例，认为西方人下围棋可能不太合适，

en.t: Taking one American beginner as my example, I thought that Westerners might not be very suited to playing go,

units.source_text: 也许有点轻率，但大家都说西方人下围棋缺乏围棋手的气质。

en.t: which may have been somewhat rash, but everyone said that Westerners lacked the temperament of go players when they played.

units.source_text: 日本的围棋已超出了娱乐和比赛的观念，成为一种技艺。

en.t: In Japan, go had already gone beyond the ideas of amusement and competition and had become an art.

units.source_text: 它贯穿着东方自古以来的神秘色彩和高雅精神。

en.t: It was permeated with the mystery and refined spirit that had belonged to the East since ancient times.

units.source_text: 本因坊秀哉名人的本因坊，也是京都寂光寺的堂塔 [1] 的称号。

en.t: The Honinbo in the title of Honinbo Shusai Meijin was also the name of a temple hall or pagoda at Jakkoji in Kyoto [1].

units.source_text: 秀哉名人也早就出家，在第一代本因坊算砂即日海大师三百年忌时，他被授予日温的法号。

en.t: Shusai Meijin had also long since entered the Buddhist priesthood, and at the three-hundredth memorial service for the first Honinbo, Sansa, that is, Master Nikkai, he was given the Buddhist name Nichion.

units.source_text: 我同美国人对局的过程，也感到这个人的国家没有围棋的传统。

en.t: In the course of my game with the American, I also felt that this man's country had no tradition of go.
